text.p: European Commission President Jacques Santer on Wednesday congratulated U.S. President Bill Clinton on his re-election and said he believed good relations between Europe and America would continue.

"I congratulate Clinton very warmly. We have very good relations and I think the U.S. and the European Union will continue to have good relations over the transatlantic agenda," Santer told Reuters Television.

Hans van den Broek, the EU commissioner responsible for relations with Russia and eastern Europe, said the United States and Europe had their problems but that having continuity in Washington would help.

"There are a number of important issues that have to be solved in the trade policy field, on the Middle East, on Bosnia and it's good to know that there's a well trained team and an experienced president that will be our partner," he said.
